name: sdd-research
description: Collect source-backed external evidence for material unknowns (API contracts, library behavior, upstream docs, version facts) into the shared research-evidence envelope. Output-only: reads no local artifacts, persists nothing, makes no product choices.
abstract: Output-only external evidence collector for SDD: verifies the received question set, collects the smallest sufficient set of external primary sources, and returns the shared research-evidence envelope with claims mapped to sources, contradictions, unresolved gaps, and freshness. Reads no local artifacts, persists nothing in any backend, and makes no product choices.
